subject: Finalizing master bill, special access & rooming for Redwood Executive Workshop - Sept 28-30
messages:
From: Brian Murphy <brian.murphy@parksidehotels.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: events@parksidehotels.com
Date: 2026-09-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood exec workshop — room block details and special access notes

Hi Olga,

Thanks for confirming the 60-room block for Sept 28-30. A couple items to confirm before I send a formal master bill:

- Room types: 40 King Standard, 15 Double Queen, 5 Executive Suites (all quoted at group rate).
- Early arrival/staggered check-in: we can hold the lobby concierge and two staffers for check-ins between 8–11am on 9/28. There’s a $500/day fee for dedicated staffing.
- Loading dock access: freight passes are required for production load-in on 9/27 (we can pre-book four 2-hour slots).
- Accessibility requests: you mentioned two ADA suites and a roll-in shower — we have two ADA suites; confirm if both should be reserved for named attendees.

Before I finalize the master bill I need: final rooming list (or template), billing contact for master bill, and any AV/staging line items you want included. I can attach a draft master bill once those are provided.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Brian
Regional Sales Director — Parkside Hotels
Attachment: site_access_map.pdf (site diagram, loading dock & parking)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Brian Murphy <brian.murphy@parksidehotels.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood exec workshop — room block details and special access notes

Hi Brian — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Please reserve the two ADA suites and note the names once we send the rooming list.
- We will provide a rooming list by EOD Tuesday (9/14). I will send a CSV with guest dietary tags and arrival windows.
- Billing contact: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com). Please put the master bill in Laura's name; Redwood will pay by corporate card + invoice.
- AV/staging: we want a small breakout riser + wired sound for Friday keynote — please include a line item for a 6'x8' stage + technician 8 hours.
- Loading dock: we need two 2-hour slots on 9/27 (production arrives midday). Confirm cost.

Could you also flag an explicit line for "keycard provisioning" and whether on-site reprogramming is available after 10pm for late arrivals.

If you send the draft master bill I can circulate internally.

Thanks,
Olga
Senior Events & Workplace Programs — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Brian Murphy <brian.murphy@parksidehotels.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood exec workshop — room block details and special access notes

Hi all — looping in billing details. A couple requests from finance:

- Can Parkside split charges between master bill (rooms & F&B) and an AV/staging line (so we can code to different GLs)?
- For the corporate card pre-authorization: Redwood prefers a $1 hold per guest at check-in rather than a large block hold. Is that doable?
- Please send master bill draft as XLSX. I've attached a rooming template we use — fill guest name, check-in/out, arrival window and dietary flag.

Thanks — once we have the XLSX we will confirm the rooming and sign off.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
Attachment: rooming_template.csv (CSV template for guest list)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Brian Murphy <brian.murphy@parksidehotels.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood exec workshop — room block details and special access notes

Brian — quick operational items from ops lead:

- Master bill draft: please include a separate "late check-in reprogramming" fee per keycard reissue and indicate SLA for same-day key updates.
- Loading dock slots confirmed for 9/27: 10:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00. Please include dock attendant charges.
- Catering: we need vegetarian and gluten-free counts for Saturday lunch — I'll populate once rooming list is in.

Marcus Lin
Events Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Brian Murphy <brian.murphy@parksidehotels.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, sasha.kim@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-09-14T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood exec workshop — room block details and special access notes

Brian — thanks for the updates. For next steps:

1) Please upload the master bill draft as an XLSX to the DocuSign link below so we can run internal approval (finance + legal). We prefer the bill broken out by room revenue, F&B, AV/staging, and event staffing.
2) Confirm the per-keycard reprogramming fee and whether you can waive the fee for guests in Executive Suites.
3) We will deliver the completed rooming_template.csv by EOD Tuesday (9/14) to laura.bennett@redwood.com. The file will include ADA names flagged and arrival windows.
4) Site access map received — thank you. Please ensure freight passes are printed and left with the dock attendant.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABC-12345

If everything looks good I'll sign off internally and route the DocuSign envelope to Laura for payment approval.

Best,
Olga
Senior Events & Workplace Programs — Redwood Inference
Attachment: master_bill_draft.xlsx (expected from Parkside)
